make_fusion_layer_concat: create a concat fusion layer using make_fusion_layer with method concat and feature_dims list
make_fusion_layer_sum: build a sum fusion layer using make_fusion_layer with method sum and matching feature_dims
ConcatFusion_forward: run ConcatFusion forward pass to concatenate input tensors along the last feature dimension
TemporalConcatFusion_forward: run TemporalConcatFusion forward pass to concatenate input tensors along the temporal dimension
ReduceFusion_custom: build a ReduceFusion layer with a custom reduce function for max, sum, or prod fusion
